params.startsAt: When this epoch's funding opens. Pass 0 to auto-schedule.

addPot(uint256).notice: Record a pot creation against an epoch. Called by PotFactory.

createEpoch(uint256).notice: Create a new epoch. Automatically chains after the previous one.      If the previous epoch is Live and past its tradingEndsAt, it is      force-settled (Live → Settling) before the new epoch is created.

epochBuffer().notice: Minimum time between epochs (buffer for settlement).

fundingDuration().notice: Duration of each phase in seconds.

goLive(uint256).notice: Transition Upcoming → Live. Opens funding. Anyone can call after startsAt.

goSettled(uint256).notice: Transition Settling → Settled. Anyone can call after endsAt.

goSettling(uint256).notice: Transition Live → Settling. Locks trading. Anyone can call after tradingEndsAt.

isFundingOpen(uint256).notice: Is funding currently open for this epoch?

isSettling(uint256).notice: Is settlement period for this epoch?

isTradingOpen(uint256).notice: Is trading currently open for this epoch? (Live status = deposits + trading)

updateTVL(uint256,uint256).notice: Update epoch TVL. Called by subgraph sync or governance.
